articles.title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
articles.description:
arXiv:2611.12941v1 Announce Type: new

articles.description:

Abstract: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. articles.title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
articles.description:
